description: This file defines the SourceEditingRedundantTagsConstraintValidator class, which validates that certain HTML tags and attributes are not redundantly added to source editing in CKEditor5 within Drupal. It implements validation logic to detect overlapping plugin capabilities and generate violation messages accordingly.

classes.name: SourceEditingRedundantTagsConstraintValidator
classes.description: Validator class ensuring no redundant tags are added to source editing, supporting plugin overlap detection and violation reporting.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on the given value against the specified constraint, checking for plugin overlaps and generating violations.

methods.name: tagHasAttributeRestrictions
methods.description: Checks if a specific HTML tag has attribute restrictions in the given HTMLRestrictions object.

methods.name: pluginsSupplyingTagsMessage
methods.description: Creates a message listing plugins and the overlapping tags they provide.
